Hi all,
I recently noticed that the F1 menu which is supposed to open the menu where I can edit a controller, isn't opening. I've tried it with all plugins off, with a brand new fresh project, and even with different computers. I'm on windows 11 and have RPGM MV through steam. Any advice?

posts.author: caethyril
posts.body: I don't think MV ever had anything like the config window seen in games made with 2k3, VX Ace, etc. MV games are browser-based, and the options are now accessed via the title/pause menus. There are no longer default options for remapping inputs, but MV's core scripts are fully exposed so you can find a plugin for it if necessary.

posts.author: Peva
posts.body: Ah that makes way more sense. Thank you!

posts.author: DevRPG2k
posts.body:
Only RmXP, VX and ACE have this menu.
RMMV and MZ have a menu in the title itself under Options to decrease or increase the volume of BGM, BGS, ME, SE and other options.
The Rm2k does not have it and the Rm2k3 only controls the Master Volume.

RPG Maker PC game controls (MV, VX Ace/VX, XP, 2003, 2000)
